why: Fourth batch: the new talk lines from 2.75.0 and earlier gaps, recorded three lines per request with Received Pronunciation asked for. Each clip passed voice-qa (after repair), a transcript check (spelling and number differences only allowed) and an accent check.

bf.day.5k1dof.heard: Bonfire Night, potatoes, parkin and warm gloves, the washing is in, and Dad has put the whirly line away. Keep the cat indoors

c2.unbox.dad.heard: Look at the size of that. Right. Mind your back on those stairs.

talk.dad.afternoon.01.heard: All right? I was just deciding whether this is a one biscuit problem or a two biscuit problem.

talk.dad.afternoon.02.heard: I've been meaning to sort my toolbox. It keeps putting up a very good argument against it.

talk.dad.afternoon.03.heard: Tell me what you're up to. Slowly, if it involves more than two buttons.

talk.dad.afternoon.05.heard: The best bit of a cup of tea is pretending it needs your full attention.

talk.dad.afternoon.06.heard: I found an old receipt for something we don't have anymore. Excellent filing that.

talk.dad.afternoon.07.heard: Do you want a hand with anything? I've still got two, despite all my repairs.

talk.dad.afternoon.09.heard: You can always ask me a question. I reserve the right to fetch a pencil first.

talk.dad.afternoon.10.heard: I reckon the afternoon goes faster once you've sat down. Someone should investigate.

talk.dad.afternoon.12.heard: No news from me, though I did find the missing end of the sticky tape.

talk.dad.context.chapter.2.heard: Saving for things teaches patience. So does waiting for somebody to finish a level.

talk.dad.context.console.dc.heard: That daydream looks rather clever. Does it come with somebody who understands the instructions?

talk.dad.context.console.sn.heard: The Super Ultra's still got plenty of life in it. So have I, despite the noises.

talk.dad.context.dow.0.heard: Monday. I'm trying to look as if I know what the week's doing.

talk.dad.context.dow.2.heard: Wednesday. The week has reached the top of the hill.

talk.dad.context.dow.3.heard: Thursday, nearly Friday, which is nearly a reason for another biscuit.

talk.dad.context.dow.4.heard: Friday at last. My watch seems rather pleased about it.

talk.dad.context.dow.5.heard: Saturday means I can put off different jobs from the weekday ones.

talk.dad.context.dow.6.heard: Sunday. I believe in resting properly. You don't want to pull a muscle relaxing.

talk.dad.context.jobDone.car.heard: Car looks much better. Thanks. I'll try not to park under anything with feathers.

talk.dad.context.jobDone.lawn.heard: Nice job on the lawn. Those stripes look more organized than I feel.

talk.dad.context.room.garden.heard: A garden's never finished. That's why I keep looking thoughtful in it.

talk.dad.context.room.kitchen.heard: I come in here for a teaspoon and leave with a sandwich. Remarkable room.

talk.dad.context.room.lounge.heard: This room has all my favorite features. Chairs, mostly.

talk.dad.context.season.autumn.heard: Autumn leaves, beautiful to look at, less beautiful to collect in a sack.

talk.dad.context.season.spring.heard: Spring. Everything grows, including the list of things to fix.

talk.dad.context.season.summer.heard: Summer's good for outdoor jobs. Also for thinking about outdoor jobs.

talk.dad.context.season.winter.heard: Winter. The season when looking out of the window counts as gardening.

talk.dad.context.weather.cold.heard: Cold forecast? My sensible jumper has been waiting for this moment.

talk.dad.context.weather.warm.heard: They reckon it'll be warm. Excellent weather for saying we'll do it tomorrow.

talk.dad.context.weather.wet.heard: Rain in the forecast? Nature's washing the car. Poorly, but the rates are good.

talk.dad.evening.01.heard: All right, you. Come and tell me what the great adventure was today.

talk.dad.evening.03.heard: My slippers are on, that's the official end of my useful hours.

talk.dad.evening.04.heard: I was going to read something improving, then I found the crossword.

talk.dad.evening.05.heard: Anything you want to ask? I'm at my wisest when nobody checks the answers.

talk.dad.evening.06.heard: Nice to have a quiet minute together. We don't need to be doing anything special.

talk.dad.evening.07.heard: I've made it through the day without losing my glasses. They're on my head, aren't they?

talk.dad.evening.08.heard: I wonder who invents the clues for crosswords? Someone who's never had to solve one.

talk.dad.evening.09.heard: Evening. My knees announced it before the clock did.

talk.dad.evening.10.heard: I've got one of those tunes stuck in my head. Unfortunately, only the unhelpful bit

talk.dad.evening.11.heard: If you need a knot undone, bring it here. I enjoy a problem that isn't electrical.

talk.dad.evening.12.heard: There's always tomorrow for that little job. That's what I told it yesterday, too.

talk.dad.morning.01.heard: Morning. I've had one cup of tea, so I'm nearly qualified to hold a conversation.

talk.dad.morning.02.heard: The toast landed butter side up. Good start. We should stop while we're ahead.

talk.dad.morning.03.heard: Did you sleep well? I was having a brilliant dream until the alarm joined in.

talk.dad.morning.04.heard: I've got a list of things to do. Writing it counts as the first thing.

talk.dad.morning.05.heard: The paper's full of things getting more expensive. Except my jokes. Still free.

talk.dad.morning.06.heard: I was up before the alarm. Wasted a perfectly good minute of sleep.

talk.dad.morning.07.heard: There's a very important job I ought to start. It'll come to me after breakfast.

talk.dad.morning.08.heard: Morning champion. That's not a prediction, I'm just being encouraging.

talk.dad.morning.09.heard: I put my watch somewhere safe last night. Apparently, too safe for this morning.

talk.dad.morning.10.heard: Do you think the kettle knows it's the hardest worker in this house?

talk.dad.morning.11.heard: I'm trying not to rush about today. It's a talent that takes years of practice.

talk.dad.morning.12.heard: I found a screw in my pocket. Something somewhere is being very brave.

talk.mom.afternoon.01.heard: How's your day going, love? You can give me the version without sound effects.

talk.mom.afternoon.02.heard: I sat down for five minutes and remembered six things. Sitting down is dangerous.

talk.mom.afternoon.03.heard: There's fruit if you're peckish. It doesn't come with a free sticker album, sadly.

talk.mom.afternoon.04.heard: I went looking for a pen and tidied a whole drawer. Still no pen.

talk.mom.afternoon.05.heard: If you find my good scissors, bring them back. The kitchen ones have gone exploring.

talk.mom.afternoon.06.heard: You look as if you've got a plan. Is it one I need to know about?

talk.mom.afternoon.07.heard: I've been reading a recipe that says, "simply". That's usually where the trouble starts.

talk.mom.afternoon.08.heard: Can you remember what I came in for? No? Good. Neither of us is showing off.

talk.mom.afternoon.09.heard: Half the afternoon gone already? Someone ought to have a word with the clock.

talk.mom.afternoon.10.heard: Come and have a chat whenever you like. I can listen and fold things at the same time.

talk.mom.afternoon.11.heard: I found a button and kept it. The cardigan it belonged to is probably long gone,

talk.mom.afternoon.12.heard: I've had a lovely quiet minute. Don't look so worried. You're allowed to speak.

talk.mom.context.chapter.2.heard: It's nice seeing you work towards something you really want.

talk.mom.context.console.u64.heard: That Ultra 64 looks comfortable there. I hope you're enjoying it, love.

talk.mom.context.dow.0.heard: Monday again. Clean page on the calendar, same washing basket.

talk.mom.context.dow.1.heard: Tuesday feels like a good day to find the missing lids. I remain optimistic.

talk.mom.context.dow.3.heard: Thursday already. I ought to stop saying I'll do it on Thursday.

talk.mom.context.dow.4.heard: Friday, I'm declaring the weekend open as soon as the dishes are done.

talk.mom.context.dow.5.heard: Saturday. A lie-in would be lovely, but the kettle doesn't bring itself up.

talk.mom.context.dow.6.heard: Sunday's for taking things gently. Even the ironing can have a little rest.

talk.mom.context.jobDone.cat.heard: Thanks for feeding the cat. Someone round here thinks you're running a hotel

talk.mom.context.jobDone.tidy.heard: Thank you for doing your room. It's lovely when asking once actually works.

talk.mom.context.jobDone.washup.heard: Thanks for washing up. You've saved my hands from turning into raisins.

talk.mom.context.room.kitchen.heard: This kitchen produces crumbs when nobody's in it, I'm certain of it.

talk.mom.context.season.autumn.heard: Autumn already, every coat pocket seems to have a leaf in it.

talk.mom.context.season.spring.heard: Spring cleaning sounds lovely, until you have to do the cleaning part.

talk.mom.context.season.summer.heard: Summer holidays ought to come with an extra fridge shelf

talk.mom.context.weather.cold.heard: Cold in the forecast. Find your jumper before you start blaming the house.

talk.mom.context.weather.wet.heard: That forecast sounds damp. Take a coat if you go out, love.

talk.mom.evening.01.heard: Have you had a good day? Tell me one good bit. It needn't be a big bit.

talk.mom.evening.03.heard: I'm not doing another useful thing tonight, unless someone needs a sandwich.

talk.mom.evening.05.heard: Those slippers have worked harder than I have. Listen to them sigh.

talk.mom.evening.06.heard: You can sit with us for a bit, love. You needn't bring a reason.

talk.mom.evening.08.heard: Did anything funny happen today? I could do with a laugh that isn't the electricity bill.

talk.mom.evening.09.heard: I've put tomorrow's list somewhere sensible. Tomorrow we'll find out where.

talk.mom.evening.10.heard: A quiet evening would be lovely. Ordinary quiet, though. Suspicious quiet means glue.

talk.mom.evening.11.heard: If you want a bedtime snack later, ask me before you build a cheese tower.

talk.mom.evening.12.heard: It's nice having everyone about, even if I do spend half the day looking for the remote.

talk.mom.job.bed.give.01.heard: Plump your pillow, fold your pyjamas, then pull the duvet straight. Tuck it and smooth it down.

talk.mom.job.bed.give.02.heard: Bed next, please. Pillow plumped, pyjamas folded, duvet pulled straight, and tucked in.

talk.mom.job.bed.remind.03.heard: Make that bed before it makes itself comfy!

talk.mom.job.bin.give.01.heard: Tie up your bedroom bin bag and bring it down to the kitchen bin, please.

talk.mom.job.bin.give.02.heard: Could you empty your bedroom bin? Tie the bag first, then take it to the kitchen bin.

talk.mom.job.bin.remind.02.heard: That bin bag still needs bringing down

talk.mom.job.bin.remind.03.heard: Don't forget to tie the bag first

talk.mom.job.bins.give.01.heard: Tie up the kitchen bag, take it to the wheelie bin, then put a fresh bag in the kitchen bin.

talk.mom.job.bins.give.02.heard: Kitchen bin out please, tie the bag, into the wheelie bin, then fit a clean kitchen bag.

talk.mom.job.bins.remind.02.heard: Out to the wheelie bin, please.

talk.mom.job.car.give.01.heard: bucket and sponge, every muddy bit of Dad's car, then rinse it off.

talk.mom.job.car.give.02.heard: Could you wash Dad's car? Sponge all the mud off with the bucket. Then give it a rinse.

talk.mom.job.car.remind.01.heard: Dad's car still needs a wash

talk.mom.job.car.remind.03.heard: Every muddy bit of the car, please.

talk.mom.job.cat.give.01.heard: Next door's cat is waiting for dinner. Shake biscuits into the bowl by the cat tree, then call the cat over.

talk.mom.job.cat.give.02.heard: Could you feed our furry visitor? Biscuits in the bowl by the cat tree, then give a call. Wait until the cat's eaten

talk.mom.job.cat.give.04.heard: Cat dinner, please. Fill the bowl by the cat tree with biscuits, then call our visitor over to eat.

talk.mom.job.cat.remind.02.heard: Our visitor's dinner is still waiting.

talk.mom.job.cat.remind.04.heard: A few biscuits in the cat's bowl, please.

talk.mom.job.cat.remind.06.heard: Bowl, biscuits, then a call. That's the one.

talk.mom.job.cat.remind.07.heard: Our furry guest hasn't had dinner yet.

talk.mom.job.cat.remind.08.heard: Feed the cat when you're ready, please.

talk.mom.job.cat.remind.10.heard: Biscuits for the cat before you forget.

talk.mom.job.cat.remind.11.heard: Cat dinner first, then back to your plans.

talk.mom.job.hoover.give.02.heard: Could you vacuum the lounge, hall, vacuum, plug in, every crumb, then put it away.

talk.mom.job.lawn.give.01.heard: Plug in the mower and cut the front lawn in stripes. Keep clear of the cable and the gnome.

talk.mom.job.plant.give.02.heard: Your spider plant needs a drink, the brown leaves picking off, and a turn to the light.

talk.mom.job.shopping.give.01.heard: Put the shopping in the fridge, freezer, cupboard or bread bin, then fold the carrier bags.

talk.mom.job.shopping.give.02.heard: Shopping away, please. Cold things cold, tins in the cupboard, bread in its bin. Fold the bags after.

talk.mom.job.shopping.remind.03.heard: find the right homes for that shopping

talk.mom.job.table.give.01.heard: Lay four places. Plates, knives, forks, and glasses. Ketchup in the middle for Dad.

talk.mom.job.table.give.02.heard: Table for four, please. A plate, knife, fork, and glass each, and the ketchup in the middle.

talk.mom.job.tidy.give.01.heard: clothes in the basket, rubbish in the bin, magazines and discs put away, dishes down to the sink please.

talk.mom.job.tidy.give.02.heard: Room tidy, love. Basket for clothes, bin for rubbish. Magazines and discs away, and bring your dishes down.

talk.mom.job.tidy.remind.01.heard: Your room's still on the list.

talk.mom.job.videos.give.01.heard: Put each video back in its place in the tower beside the telly, please.

talk.mom.job.washup.give.01.heard: Plug the sink, hot water and washing up liquid, scrub the dishes and stand them in the rack.

talk.mom.job.washup.give.02.heard: Could you wash up? Hot, soapy water in the plugged sink, scrub everything, then into the rack.

talk.mom.morning.01.heard: Morning love. I've put the kettle on. That's my first sensible decision of the day.

talk.mom.morning.02.heard: Sleep all right? You looked as though you were solving sums in your sleep.

talk.mom.morning.03.heard: There's toast if you're hungry. The first slice is the practice one.

talk.mom.morning.04.heard: I found a sock in the washing basket with no partner. Another mysterious disappearance.

talk.mom.morning.05.heard: Have a proper breakfast. A biscuit held over a cereal bowl doesn't count.

talk.mom.morning.06.heard: Your hair's doing something adventurous this morning. Shall we call it a style?

talk.mom.morning.08.heard: One thing at a time today. That's advice for me as much as you.

talk.mom.morning.09.heard: Did you hear the birds? They're having a much busier morning than I am.

talk.mom.morning.10.heard: I've already reheated my tea once. It's becoming a family heirloom.

talk.mom.morning.11.heard: You can have the last bit of jam. Leave the jar, I haven't washed it yet.

talk.mom.morning.12.heard: Nice to see you before lunchtime. I was starting to think your duvet had adopted you.
